title: [GAP-7] Limits and quotas are scattered, partly local policy, and lack floors
description: Review finding GAP-7: Limits and quotas are scattered, partly local policy, and lack floors (lens GAP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:40, 90, 572; spec/11-transport.md:112, 303-304; spec/12-security.md:61; spec/10-relays.md:540; spec/02-identity.md:346. Fix: Confirmed. 11:112 says "Limit values are local Relay policy" and sets no floor. Presence is re-sent every 30 s on each channel topic (05:559, 572), and nothing caps DM size, state size or body length. Correct one example: Welcomes never go to relays (05:51; they are POSTed to the `KeyPackageEndpoint`), so the 64 KiB envelope limit does not apply to a 500-leaf Welcome. The real size risk on relays is a Commit that batches many Adds, since each carries a KeyPackage. The fix is otherwise as proposed. Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
